_comment: Public endpoints probed by scripts/uptime-check.mjs on a schedule.
This replaces the availability monitoring that lived in the
jasperfordesq-ai/api.project-nexus.net repository, which was archived on
2026-08-10. Archiving a repository disables its scheduled workflows.
🔴 The ASP.NET API (api.project-nexus.net) and Web UK frontend
(uk.project-nexus.net) were REMOVED from this list on 2026-08-10, when the
owner retired them. Their containers were stopped deliberately, so both
hosts now return 503 by design. Monitoring a service you switched off on
purpose is how a monitor teaches its owner to ignore it.
If either is ever restarted, add it back with track 'experimental'.
Every entry MUST be an unauthenticated GET against a public URL. Do not
add an endpoint that requires a credential, mutates state, or is not
already public - this file is committed to a PUBLIC repository.
🔴 The TWO community accessible domains were added on 2026-08-17. They have
served web-uk since 2026-08-14, and until this date only the main accessible
host was probed - so a fault affecting one community's own accessible address
(its vhost, its certificate) would not have been noticed. A fault that takes
the accessible frontend down platform-wide was already covered by the main
host; a per-host one was not.
🔴 The AWID community accessible domain was added on 2026-09-02, the day that
community's own hostnames (awid.timebank.global and
accessible-awid.timebank.global) were attached to the platform. Add both
entries for every new community accessible domain at the point the vhost is
created, not later: the vhost files and the origin certificate binding live
only on the server, so a per-host fault is invisible to every other check.
🔴 The /version entries now assert the response BODY says nexus-webuk, not
merely that something returned 200. The entry named 'not a silent fallback'
did not actually verify that: a React SPA answers 200 on any path, so a vhost
pointed at the wrong container would have passed a status-only check while
serving members the wrong application.
